question: How is the goddess urged to receive the next wondrous teaching?
premises: She is asked to listen with a one-pointed mind.
inference: The speaker urges the goddess to hear another wondrous teaching with focused attention.
uncertainties: The particle ta in śṛṇutaikāgramānasam is morphologically unclear in this fused form.
plain_english: O goddess, hear also another wondrous thing with a one-pointed mind.
